title: 📢Community Event: "What's on my desk?"
content:
## _Hello everyone!_

## _We are excited to announce our first community event:_

## **_"What's on my desk?" 🎉_**

This event is all about sharing the unique and creative setups of your workspaces. Whether it's your home office, studio, or any place where you get things done, we want to see it!  


* * *

# **How to participate:**

  1. Take a photo of your desk or workspace.

  2. Share it in **@General board as a post.**

  3. Add a brief description of your setup and any interesting items you have on your desk

title: 2nd Avatar becomes a 'Ghost'
content:
Hello,  
  
When I save a file with two avatars and two garments to compare sizes, the second avatar becomes invisible when I reopen the file, but it is still there.

After making it visible again, it seems to have lost its collision value, causing the garment assigned to it to fall through the avatar and land on the floor.  
  
The avatar I'm using is MV2.1_Jinho but other avatars have the same issue.  
  
Situation before saving. Both avatars are visible and holding the garments.  


![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202501/449095b3b4874d12be01c6372e734455/images/061c5259b3fa48378f13f2560b4618a92025-01-14%2019_29_31-Greenshot.png.jpg)

  
After re-opening the second avatar become invisible but is still there.  


![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202501/449095b3b4874d12be01c6372e734455/images/f5c61f734f694657b289562ad2c97cb52025-01-14%2018_47_31-Greenshot.png.jpg)

  
After hitting the show avatar symbol twice to make the avatar reappear- and  
then simulate, the garment falls through the avatar as if it was a 'Ghost'.  


![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202501/449095b3b4874d12be01c6372e734455/images/40e5ef6796ba4133b90ce0c8be0218d92025-01-14%2018_46_44-Greenshot.png.jpg)

  
Is there a way to fix this by changing some properties or settings?

I wasn't able to find any differences between the two avatars in the property window.  
  
Thank you :-)  
  
EDIT:  
After some experimenting, I found that temporarily activating the "Divide Mesh" option seems to restore the collision ability of the second avatar. This will be my workaround for now whenever I reopen a file with more than one avatar.

However, I am still wondering if there is a way to prevent this issue from occurring in the first place.  
  


![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202501/449095b3b4874d12be01c6372e734455/images/e8c232fe0fef49a1a828531d5ea14b5c2025-01-15%2011_31_51-Greenshot.png.jpg)

  
  



### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: Hi, I cannot replicate this. Please share an affected file to us as a wetransfer upload here via the contact form: https://clo3d.com/en/support/contactus
content_description: This web page aims to address and provide solutions for the issue of avatars becoming invisible and losing collision properties when reopening files in a 3D garment simulation software.

title: Please update CLOLiveSync plugin to work with DX12
content:
Okay this plugin has been amazing for my workflow with CLO3D and Unreal Engine 5, however its been months now and we can only use DirectX11 to get it working with **Lumen illumination**.  
  
**Please please please** someone needs to address this, update your plugin so we can use DirectX12 which is **WAY** better for rendering and illumination.   
Dx11 is outdated and doesn't work well with new stuff coming to Unreal Engine 5.   
  
If somebody knows why the plugin still hasn't been updated I'd like to know, it might help me finding workarounds.   
I'll be looking for some technical answer, thank u all.   
  


![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202501/c998ae78c0fc4ca9851cc78e573fe164/images/4da813a4d4424f1481ac97b871d96d91179170-1537541164.png)![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202501/c998ae78c0fc4ca9851cc78e573fe164/images/fe7832f18d174123be692586a0e55b51028240012f1a46baaee843feead3ee75.png)

title: How do I get waistband to stop clipping behind 2 layers offabric?
content:
Hello! I'm trying to make a piece that has a separate midsection, with a waistband on the top and bottom of the section. I'm having an issue with the waistbands clipping behind the mid-section. I've done superimopose(side), and set the order to be brought to front for the waistbands but I still can't fix the issue. I've provided pictures below, but please let me know if you need any more info to offer advice.

Thank you!!

![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202501/6e4dbc24ab7c468f8690d2bff27f7caf/images/e2b1ff61138e4db18acb2e9fb2a93663Screenshot%20%285%29.png)

![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202501/6e4dbc24ab7c468f8690d2bff27f7caf/images/29e51cecf54d43178076a6f557e19979Screenshot%20%287%29.png)

![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202501/6e4dbc24ab7c468f8690d2bff27f7caf/images/035d79a4f3a44b709f6f9d2bdd7d7fe1Screenshot%20%286%29.png)


### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: What exactly is meant by this: "set the order to be brought to front for the waistbands"? The arrangement in the 3D window before simulation? You can use Set Sublayer: https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115013802288-Set-Sublayer-Pattern I opposite to setting the layer (PE) away from 0, it doesn't have to be removed. However, to get the pieces to come out, of course changing the layer is an option, but we recommend to remove it after the simulation has settled.
Reply 1: You're a gem, the sublayer tool worked best for what I'm trying to do. Will definitely keep this tool in mind.

Comment 2: Hi, I see the layer of the belt is 0. Have you tried changing the layer of belt to 1?
content_description: "Request advice on resolving waistband clipping issues in a garment design featuring a separate midsection."
